item.description: La Unión Europea está preocupada por las enormes exportaciones chinas de vehículos eléctricos baratos. item.title: Carlos Martínez Assad: "Los partidos árabes nunca habían votado tanto en Israel"
item.description: La jornada electoral en Israel muestra un escenario que ya estaban contemplados, es decir, que la elección no se decidirá el día de hoy sino luego del juego de alianza de los partidos. Por otro lado, los partidos árabes han mostrado una participación mayor, pues incluso en ocasiones anteriores dichos partidos habían optado por la abstención. item.title: For its autocratic African ally, Taiwan bites its tongue and opens its wallet
item.description: Eswatini probably does not register on most people’s mental maps. Its relatively recent name might sound unfamiliar as many people still know it as Swaziland. That it demands attention from pundits like yours truly has much to do with it being the only African country that still formally recognises Taiwan. It is also the continent’s only absolute monarchy. The two facts are closely connected. Recognising Taipei makes little sense when every one of eSwatini’s neighbours recognises Beijing, but it... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: A 219-acre Florida cattle ranch facing development pressure was approved for a $20.15 million conservation easement in September 2026, allowing agriculture to continue while permanently restricting development
item.description: A 219-acre cattle ranch in Florida received protection through a $20.15 million conservation agreement. This easement is part of a broader initiative preserving over 4,500 acres of agricultural land. The agreement ensures that the ranch can remain operational while preventing future development. It reflects efforts to balance agricultural needs with urban expansion pressures in the state. Protecting this land is vital for maintaining both wildlife habitats and agricultural sustainability. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
